title: Metric card with sliding highlight and chart swap
summary: One light dashboard card settles in while its line chart draws on and two figures roll up; a lime highlight then slides to the second tile and the chart wipes over to that metric's series before the card folds away.
use_when: Showing one growth metric and a second related figure in a 5 s loop
Investor or launch slide where a single chart proves a claim
Silent feed or website hero loop for a data or analytics product
Comparing two series that share one axis without cutting

look.type_style: geometric grotesk, sentence case; two-line card title (dark line over grey line) ~3 % H; tile figures regular weight ~4.5 % H, tabular; tiny tracked uppercase labels and link

sfx.event: figures roll to their final value
highlight lands on the second tile
chart wipes to the second series

structure.shot: white frame; a pale card with a two-line title, two metric tiles (first lime), an area line chart and a small link row, then holds
structure.camera: locked frame; card scale 1.17 -> 1.00 f6-f24, centred
structure.motion: 4 empty frames; card fades in f4-f12; lime fill grows from a thin vertical bar to the full first tile f6-f24, springs.layout (overshoot not measurable); line draws left to right with area fill following, easings.outQuint ~21 fr (f6-f27); figures roll up digit by digit, last digit lands f27; settled f27, hold to f67

structure.shot: same card: the lime highlight moves from the first tile to the second and the chart swaps to a flatter second series, then holds
structure.motion: highlight leaves tile one and slides right as a stretched bar into tile two f66-f78, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); old series erased and new series drawn left to right in one sweep f66-f90, easings.linear (±0.25 s); hold f90-f120

structure.shot: card folds away: figures roll out, the first tile collapses, the lime tile narrows to a sliver, then white frame
structure.camera: locked frame; card scale 1.00 -> ~0.85 and fades f120-f135
structure.motion: figures roll out from the leading digit f120-f126; card fades with easings.inExpo ~15 fr (f120-f135); chart erased left to right; lime sliver last out f135; white hold f135-f150 (matches frame 0, loop point)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg white, surface for the card, accent for the highlight tile, fg and muted for the title lines
params.content.title: two-line card title: subject line (fg) and qualifier line (muted), 1-2 words each
params.content.metrics: exactly 2 tiles: {label, value, delta} each, value up to 5 digits, delta a short percent chip
params.content.series: 2 number arrays, one per tile, same length (~20 points) on a shared 0-max axis
params.content.link: small uppercase link line at the card foot, 2-3 words with an arrow
params.timing.switchAt: frame of the highlight move and chart swap (default 66 at 30 fps)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0, 2, 4 s: entrance f4-f27, highlight switch f66-f78, chart sweep f66-f90, exit f120-f135, white frames f0-f3 and f135-f149 so the loop closes on white. The card never cuts; one locked frame. Highlight-slide between tiles and series-swap wipe are not in the vocabulary (see recipe.md Proposed terms). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Text colour not in palette: dark text is too small for palettegen.
